key_reasoning.reason: diffstat reports 13 files (XL by count), but most are git mv renames of compressors into a subpackage with small import edits; net change is only 187 insertions and 103 deletions, so the count overstates real effort.

Behavior-preserving, but SDK module globals became a lock-guarded _SDKRuntime singleton (double-checked locking, sticky unavailable flag, executor lifecycle) and factory globals became lru_cache helpers (process-wide cached compressor, cached one-shot warnings). Concurrency and cache-lifetime semantics need care and a test reset hook; no new security surface. No calibration examples were found under .ai-run, so no anchor example was compared.
